title: The Hero Laughs While Walking the Path of Vengeance a Second Time
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kaito Ukei, summoned to another world as a hero, defeats the sorceress but is betrayed and killed by his own party. He wakes at the moment of his first summoning with his memories intact and sets out to torture and kill the companions who betrayed him. The English manga ran two volumes before cancellation (MU).
life_message: Betrayal justifies merciless personal revenge, and only those bound to you cannot betray you.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Betrayal must be answered personally and brutally (AniList blurb; MU Revenge).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Kaito acts outside every law and institution.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Trusts only those bound to him, such as his slave (Anime UK News, LN).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Princess and royals among the betrayers; rank gives no protection (MU Princess/es).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: No religious frame; pragmatic calculation of revenge.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Trust no one; survival and control above all (MU Trust Issues).

folkways.japan: A web-novel isekai revenge story; the genre's power fantasy reflects online light-novel trends rather than traditional Japanese norms.

delivery.evidence: Reviewers find no moral message, only revenge and torture (ANN manga guide; Anime UK News on the LN).

personified.ideology: Revenge as justice; trust no one

delivery.note: The betrayers get little development in volume 1, so the case against revenge is not voiced (ANN).

winners_losers: Kaito wins as he hunts his former allies; the betrayers and bystanders lose, and the vengeful worldview gets the story's sympathy.
